interfaces_reviewed: the §10 adapter: psycopg_pool over the approved pins (D-048) — verify-full with the pinned root CA, the arv_app least-privilege runtime shape (never the migration role; the postgres/superuser runtime refuses by name), explicit ProdConfig only (no environment fallback; the loopback rig UNTOUCHED — local and production separate by construction)

the §8.5 lease: SET LOCAL app.current_owner inside the transaction; after COMMIT and after ROLLBACK the connection carries NO owner context (the two-user reuse race and the rollback cleanliness, both proven on the rig through the SAME psycopg driver)

the leak class found in testing: an un-scoped read (autocommit=False) leaves an OPEN implicit transaction; the next lease's transaction() nests as a savepoint and SET LOCAL LEAKED across the inner 'commit' — an interleaved read captured the prior owner. Closed: EVERY lease is transaction-scoped; ARV-PRD-011 pins the class with a behavioral check
